cds.title: Clark University Common Data Set 2024-2025 (PDF, Strategic Analytics, Assessment & Institutional Research)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set 2024-2025 (fall 2024 entering class): 11,452 applied (men 5,087 + women 6,339 + unknown gender 26), 4,528 admitted (1,737 + 2,776 + 15), 486 enrolled (the enrolled rows add up to 486). The residency rows (in-state, out-of-state, international) are blank except for the totals, so those counts are null; the early decision and early action counts are also blank. Waitlist: 730 offered, 309 accepted, 57 admitted. Clark also posted a 2025-26 CDS file (CDS_-2025_26.pdf) but its numbers are not in the PDF's text layer (only the question text extracts), so the 2024-25 CDS is used. Test scores are optional (C8A: 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'); 16% submitted the SAT and 5% the ACT, so the percentiles describe a small self-selected group. The CDS prints the SAT section percentiles as 658/700/740 (reading and writing) and 630/658/720 (math), which are not multiples of 10; they are shown as printed. The GPA breakdown is for all enrolled students and only 61.9% reported a GPA. Undergraduate enrollment (2,271) and the nonresident count (141) are the B2 'Total Undergraduates' column; B1 lists 2,266 total undergraduates.
